probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Overview Buy Hemingway Magazine Fashion Design Music Culture Travel Podcast Latest: Making records slowly About Authors Membership Contact Sign in The tailor who refuses to hurry Authors Three writers around one table. Everyone edits everyone else before a piece goes out. Erik Lindqvist Music and travel editor Erik Lindqvist edits the music and travel pages and hosts Conversations, the Quaderno podcast. He is drawn to small labels, record shops and anywhere the night train goes. 3 essays, 4 episodes hosted Night train to the north Sleeves you can read from across the room Islands without cars Juliet Ramos Design and culture writer Juliet Ramos covers design and the small rooms where culture happens: studios, workshops, a cinema with thirty seats. She is interested in the decisions you can only see up close. 3 essays A room for thirty people The chair that took four years The studio with no logo Lorenzo Bassi Editor Lorenzo Bassi edits Quaderno and writes about fashion and the people who keep a city running at night.
